title: Uniaxial tension of a J2 bilinear-hardening cube to large strain (explicit)
source: von Mises plasticity with linear isotropic hardening under uniaxial stress (Simo and Hughes, Computational Inelasticity, Springer 1998, §2.3); logarithmic strain for a hypoelastic–plastic law under coaxial stretching

quantities.quantity: axial Cauchy stress at a logarithmic strain of 0.2
quantities.reason: uniaxial J2 with linear hardening: σ = σ_y + E_t (ε − σ_y/E) in logarithmic strain; the stretch takes 10⁴ wave transits, so inertia and the ringing of the start (ρcv ≈ 0.1% of σ) stay well under 1%
ε_p = ε − σ/E, as for the stress
